name: Horn-Renaming Defect Operation Laws
statement: Cube symmetries and constant-coordinate extensions preserve $H$. Every nonempty pc-minor $D$ of $C$ satisfies $H(D)\leq H(C)$, and binary classes on disjoint coordinate sets satisfy $H(A\times B)=H(A)+H(B)$.
proof: Projection retains exactly the minimal missing patterns supported on surviving coordinates. A minimal missing pattern of a conditioning injects into an original pattern with at least its pair cost. Product minimal missing patterns lie wholly in one factor, so their costs and the minimizing reflections separate.
